name: dsh-computer-use-native
description: Windows Node-API provider for DSH Computer Use

scripts.install: node -e "const root=process.cwd(); try { require('node-gyp-build')(root); } catch (error) { if (process.platform !== 'win32' || process.arch !== 'x64') process.exit(0); console.error('dsh-computer-use-native: prebuilt provider unavailable, building locally'); require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, [require.resolve('node-gyp/bin/node-gyp.js'), 'rebuild'], {cwd:root,stdio:'inherit'}); }"
